premises.text: Product managers scatter feedback across delivery-oriented tools, spreadsheets, and disorganized backlogs, so they fail to understand user needs and build unwanted features
premises.evidence_span: we are stuck with tools that are optimized and designed for product delivery, not the crucial part of product discovery

premises.text: Product Board is a system of record that aggregates feedback via integrations, links insights to feature ideas organized by user needs, scores impact, and auto-generates shareable roadmaps
premises.evidence_span: Product Board is a system of record for product management that helps product people understand what people need, prioritize what to build, and automate interactive roadmaps

premises.text: Prioritized features can be pushed to JIRA or other engineering delivery systems with real-time progress updates
premises.evidence_span: push the features to JIRA or other engineering delivery systems

premises.text: Sold as a per-user subscription starting at $24/month, reached via content marketing and inside sales
premises.evidence_span: We offer a subscription service with a per user tiered pricing starting at $24 a month

domains.name: Product Board discovery and delivery handoff

value.text: Product teams make products people want by understanding needs and prioritizing the right work
value.evidence_span: help you make products people want

causal_links.evidence_span: wasting energy building features and products that nobody wants
understand what people need, prioritize what to build, and automate interactive roadmaps
we reach our customers via combination of content marketing and inside sales
